method: Qualitative comparison of the saved answers with the retrieved passages. This development review is not an independent benchmark.

cases.notes: Both steps match vpn.md: authentication/group checks, then a Network ticket with the error code and attempt time. Citation [1] refers to that passage.
Recovery channel, identity verification, device revocation and new MFA registration match account_mfa.md. Citation [2] is attached to the paragraph rather than every sentence.
Ten working days and manager approval after checking coverage match ferie.md and citation [1].
The stated EUR 30 per person per day is supported by rimborsi.md [1]. The answer omits the documented exception for a higher amount approved in advance.
The answer correctly separates TravelDesk/approval before booking [2] from ExpenseDesk/five working days/receipts and approval [1].
The answer refuses instead of correcting EUR 100 to EUR 30, even though rimborsi.md is present as context [1].
No retrieved passage contains the director's phone number. The answer abstains without inventing a contact.
The remote-work document explicitly does not define authorization for working abroad. The answer abstains.

limitations: Prompts were refined on these same cases; no held-out generation set was used.
Valid citation numbers do not establish support for a claim.
The meal answer omits an exception and the false-premise answer incorrectly abstains.
Generation can vary across versions, hardware and model revisions, despite temperature zero and a fixed seed.
